name: 🎨Draw Or Oof!
desc:
🎨 Welcome to Draw Or Oof! 🎮
The ultimate drawing game with high intensity and even higher rewards! 😱

🖌️ Every round, you're given a prompt and have 2 minutes to create your masterpiece. ⏳
👀 Then, it's time to vote... but watch out—the worst drawing gets eliminated... 💀

💥 Are you ready for the challenge?
 Like ❤️ and favorite ⭐
